newsitem.title: POLAND: Echo to issue up to 400,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: Echo to issue up to 400,000 shares.

text.p: Polish developer Echo Investment SA will ask shareholders on May 28 to issue 150,000 to 400,000 new shares ex-rights, the company said in a statement on Monday, giving no other details.
In March the company said the foreseen issue would be at a minimum price of 75 zlotys per share and amount to about 10 percent of its hitherto issued stock.
Proceeds from the issue would finance planned investment.
Echo on Monday also said that this year it would continue its policy of paying no dividend.
It will also propose shareholders to convert 40,000 registered shares into common shares, the statement said.
